selection.rule: of the ten Dec 5, 2015 archives, the game with the most corroborated shots in the window stage's own per-game filing (window.py's Pass 2: a detected release whose anchor residual passes the gate); every count compared ships below, and the argmax must be unique

fold.rule: one scene per ball-half segment: every body folds toward the hoop of the half the ball is in (window.py:to_shot_frame), the segment flipping only when the ball crosses 4.0 ft past midcourt (FOLD_HYSTERESIS_FT, authored; the 2.0 ft alternate's segment count ships beside it); every path is cut at a fold boundary

events.pass_rule: measure_movement's own: consecutive same-team different-carrier touches in one period within 1200 ms; the bead sits at the frame the ball reached its receiver

carriers.note: the ball was held - anonymous period-relative spans, exactly window.py's touch chain, no body named

possession.rule: smallest-residual corroborated shot whose 125-frame span ends at the release inside one period, one fold segment and unbroken feed

game_grid.fold: each body toward its own nearer hoop - the wash's own rule, so this game's cells are a subset of its night's

treatment: cut at every step over paint.py:MAX_STEP_FT, every feed gap over the game's own modal spacing times window.py:FRAME_GAP_FACTOR, and every fold boundary; runs under paint.py:MIN_RUN_FRAMES dropped; Douglas-Peucker at paint.py:SIMPLIFY_FT with zone crossings forced, exactly as the paint; spans over paint.py:MAX_VERTEX_FRAMES split at real measured frames (stroke_from's split_over), never refused and never interpolated
identity: the matchup is re-derivable from the disclosed selection rule and ships in it - between the slate's anonymity and the traces' named-on-purpose, an open publication decision. No body is named: a stroke carries a per-period first-appearance slot (ball = 255); game-scoped slots were rejected because a slot held across periods reads against the public box score as a minutes pattern

game_strokes.fields: x, y (int16 tenths, hoop at origin); dt (uint16 frames); arc (uint16 tenths)

game_index.fields: first vertex (uint32); count (uint16); start (uint16 frames, period-relative); period (uint8); kind (uint8, 1 = ball); body (uint8 per-period slot, 255 = ball)
